Acquisition: Daifuku acquired 100% of Eisenmann GmbH (Germany), which designs and engineers industrial painting / surface-treatment equipment and conveyor systems, mainly for European automakers and industrial parts makers, for JPY 16,613 million in cash on July 1, 2026 (share transfer agreement signed April 17, 2026). The company states it adds European-standard system solutions and a stronger European base to its automotive production-line business, complementing existing operations and widening integrated proposals.
